question: For molecules containing single bonds, calculate the percentage of carbon atoms versus hydrogen atoms. Then, among molecules with chlorine atoms, determine whether carcinogenic or non-carcinogenic molecules are more common.

prediction.sql:
WITH SingleBondMolecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule AS m
    INNER JOIN bond AS b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '-'
),
AtomCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hydrogen_count
    FROM atom AS a
    INNER JOIN SingleBondMolecules AS sbm ON a.XCL_002 = sbm.XCL_010
),
ClMolecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule AS m
    INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'cl'
),
CarcinogenicCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_carcinogenic_count
    FROM molecule AS m
    INNER JOIN ClMolecules AS cm ON m.XCL_010 = cm.XCL_010
)
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN ac.hydrogen_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (ac.carbon_count * 100.0) / ac.hydrogen_count END AS carbon_vs_hydrogen_percentage,
    CASE 
        WHEN cc.carcinogenic_count > cc.non_carcinogenic_count THEN 'carcinogenic'
        WHEN cc.non_carcinogenic_count > cc.carcinogenic_count THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS more_common
FROM AtomCounts AS ac
CROSS JOIN CarcinogenicCounts AS cc

WITH SingleBondMolecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule AS m
    INNER JOIN bond AS b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '-'
),
AtomCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hydrogen_count
    FROM atom AS a
    INNER JOIN SingleBondMolecules AS sbm ON a.XCL_002 = sbm.XCL_010
),
ClMolecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule AS m
    INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'cl'
),
CarcinogenicCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_carcinogenic_count
    FROM molecule AS m
    INNER JOIN ClMolecules AS cm ON m.XCL_010 = cm.XCL_010
)
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN ac.hydrogen_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (ac.carbon_count * 100.0) / ac.hydrogen_count END AS carbon_vs_hydrogen_percentage,
    CASE 
        WHEN cc.carcinogenic_count > cc.non_carcinogenic_count THEN 'carcinogenic'
        WHEN cc.non_carcinogenic_count > cc.carcinogenic_count THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS more_common
FROM AtomCounts AS ac
CROSS JOIN CarcinogenicCounts AS cc
